payload.summary: Planned fitness-function-driven development as a third feedback loop alongside spec-driven and test-driven development, based on a repo audit showing quality machinery exists but is unwired. Approach 1 (extend existing machinery in place) selected at Gate 1; coordinated tier; five staged work packages plus contracts.

decisions.title: Extend in place, no fitness-function registry
decisions.rationale: Audit's central finding is machinery exists but is unwired; a registry abstracts over signals (coverage, architecture severities) that don't exist yet. Registry recorded as follow-up once several fitness functions exist.

decisions.title: Axis enum grows to 8 values, all three copies move together with an identity test
decisions.rationale: Canonical schema, install_assets mirror, and agents.yaml inline copy drift silently today; a copy-identity test turns future drift into a test failure.

decisions.title: Consensus matching gains axis as first-class field
decisions.rationale: consensus_synthesizer.py silently drops axis, contradicting documented (axis, file_path, line_range) matching; fixing it is prerequisite for NFR findings to survive review.

decisions.title: Architecture gate is config-ratcheted: advisory now, blocking flip after 3 clean runs
decisions.rationale: Immediate blocking risks failing in-flight changes on pre-existing findings; mirrors context-drift-gate rollout precedent. New dependency cycles are the first blocking check.

decisions.title: DEGRADED is a first-class gate status distinct from PASS
decisions.rationale: GATEKEEPER fallback, sub-2-vendor review, and --allow-degraded-pass currently fail open indistinguishably from passing; hard gate blocks on DEGRADED required phases unless --accept-degraded is explicitly passed and logged.

decisions.title: Supersede validate-feature-findings-gate
decisions.rationale: Untouched change (0/31 tasks) targeting the same gate/schema surface; marked superseded per add-update-documentation-skill precedent.

next_steps: Gate 2 approval, then /implement-feature introduce-fitness-function-gates starting with wp-schema.
Record validate-feature-findings-gate as superseded in this proposal (task 1.6) so no one starts it in parallel.
